title: Ohm Boy Pear Apple & Raspberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pear Apple & Raspberry from Ohm Boy is a fruity symphony that harmonizes to create an unforgettable vaping experience. Crisp Pear, succulent Apple, and plump Raspberries blend together in perfect balance, delivering layers of sweetness and tartness with every puff. Prepare to be captivated by the refreshing and well-rounded combination of these exquisite fruits. Shortfill bottles from Ohm Boy E-liquids provide the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in Shortfills. Ohm Boy has emerged as one of the most innovative e-liquid manufacturers in the UK, thanks to flavours that refine and push the boundaries of e-juices into delicious new territory. Their range covers a wide spectrum of fruit and beverage blends, always with a unique take on flavours with captivating and complex characteristics.
